records.title: Learning to Reweight Examples for Robust Deep Learning
records.operation: Perturb per-example loss coefficients from zero; unroll one weighted SGD update; take held clean meta-loss derivative with respect to those coefficients; rectify positive usefulness and normalize; take actual weighted model update. Eq12 explicitly expresses train/meta gradient alignment.
records.candidate_overlap: Finite adaptation used to judge usefulness, data-weighted updates, backward-on-backward credit are prior.
records.difference: Candidate scores actual per-member class-competitor margin change on inner support after a nonzero own-CE private step, then graph/balance-allocates across members; it does not use Ren's held-meta-loss epsilon derivative as its response cost.
records.equivalence_scope: Small-step candidate response is a gradient-alignment approximation, not exact Ren weight equality.
records.limits: Clean unbiased meta-data assumptions, rectification/normalization, selector/recipe and robustness results are not inherited. Proofs, author code and experiments not qualified.

records.title: Meta-Weight-Net: Learning an Explicit Mapping For Sample Weighting
records.operation: MLP maps scalar training loss to a [0,1] sample weight; a weighted SGD function is differentiated using clean meta data to update weight-map parameters, then a classifier step is recomputed with updated weights. Printed classifier update treats weights as coefficients; Eq6 uses meta/train gradient alignment.
records.candidate_overlap: Partial classifier/private derivative with weights supplied as independent coefficients, retained outer weight-map credit and recomputed actual learner update are established bilevel practice.
records.difference: Candidate has no separate weight MLP; Q is a fixed finite differentiable graph/balanced responsibility map of private response costs, with shared theta owning the outer meta-gradient and persistent private blocks.
records.equivalence_scope: Same weighting/meta ownership pattern; not exact complete algorithm identity.
records.limits: Clean balanced meta-data, convergence/robustness claims and native recipe are not inherited. Algorithm1 refers to Eq9 although displayed parameter update in the inspected body is Eq4; source behavior not inspected. No port is qualified.
